One Fred. Many Roles.
Use Fred across sales, recruiting, marketing, and leadership.
Sales
Prepare for calls, capture customer context, update your CRM, and keep deals moving.
Recruiting
Capture interviews, compare candidates, create reports, and keep hiring teams aligned.
Marketing
Turn customer and team knowledge into insights, content, reports, and campaigns.
Leadership
Get daily briefs, team updates, and quick answers on decisions.
Works With the Tools You Already Use
Fred connects with 240+ apps your team works in every day.
Notes from every call on Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and more.
Email
Connect Gmail or Outlook. Fred sorts your inbox and drafts replies and follow-ups.
Collaboration
Bring Fireflies context into the tools your team already uses, like Slack and Notion.
CRM
Sync sales calls and deal updates to HubSpot, Salesforce, and 25+ CRMs.
Project Management
Turn action items into tasks in 15+ tools, including Jira, Asana, and Trello.
ATS
Send interview notes and scorecards to Ashby, Greenhouse, and Gem, and more
Enterprise-Grade Security
Fireflies is the preferred platform for CIOs across the Fortune 500, offering robust admin controls and stringent security protocols.
ISO 42001
Certified to the international standard for governing and managing AI responsibly.
SOC 2 Type II
Fireflies follows industry standards for data security, privacy, and confidentiality.
GDPR & Data Privacy
Fireflies does not use your meetings, transcripts, or conversations to train AI models, and our AI vendors are contractually barred from training on them. Your data stays yours.
HIPAA & FERPA
BAA for healthcare and DSA for education, available on Enterprise with Private Storage.
